_description: Weights & Biases Weave call/eval export → AKSI control ID mapping. Weave (https://weave.wandb.ai) instruments LLM and agent code, exporting per-call records via /api/v2/calls/stream_query. Each call has an `op_name` (e.g. 'openai.ChatCompletion.create', 'weave.Evaluation.summarize', or user-defined ops) plus an optional `summary.scores` block with named evaluator outputs. Op-name patterns map to AKSI controls; score-name → control + threshold mapping mirrors the Braintrust importer. Score values may be aggregate dicts ({mean, stderr, ...}) or scalars; both are handled. Inverted scores (lower-is-better) are mapped against an inverted threshold band.
